boundaries.evidence: Native controls cover byte-valued chars and Unicode/escape boundaries; official compiler Unicode differences must be distinguished from UPLC PrettyConst.
boundaries.resolution: Retain native controls and source-exhaustive scalar handling; propagate a pin/compiler change to the native oracle.

boundaries.scope: Native JSON Value, Scientific and streaming injection result/parse-error presentation.

boundaries.scope: Complete supported ApplyTxErr, era mismatch, context collection and CLI rejection presentation.
boundaries.evidence: Recorded explicit-error refusals now compare whole bytes; ordinary malformed/admission/free-text Mempool paths, missing #434 recordings and #401 era/family completeness need independent exposure proof.
boundaries.resolution: Complete all native categories and ordered accumulated failures; no projection, provider description or synthetic substitute may satisfy a native refusal row.

boundaries.scope: Script context, evaluation/decode/scope error, failing term/constants/types and layout embedded in native refusals.
boundaries.evidence: All native EvaluationError families are required; current finite context/explicit-error controls do not establish general error/term coverage.
boundaries.resolution: Capture lossless typed diagnostics; complete Pretty/Show/layout and every native family; prove actual exposure of variable Flat decoder strings before defining goldens.

boundaries.scope: Generic/Cardano handshake rejection constructors, version data decoding and refusal text emitted to peers.
boundaries.evidence: Handshake.cardanoProfile.refusalText delegates to ProtocolError.message and emits it in WireReason.DecodeError/Refused. Existing generic mock-domain text controls do not compare actual Cardano decoder/agreement text.
boundaries.resolution: Implement source-verified typed VersionData errors, native record/CBOR-Term Show and check order; remove unapproved local caps that prevent native messages; compare complete native rejection bytes/text at the active pin.

boundaries.scope: Native local-address/file-descriptor/system-error Show payloads at the network trace boundary.
native: ouroboros-network@2fb69829:network-mux and network socket exception trace payloads; pinned source citations in SystemError
boundaries.evidence: SystemError.ofNumber and ErrnoCause.Unrecognised currently retain non-native provider fallbacks; inline captured strings lack a retained observation manifest. Native content in NodeEvent must be distinguished from approved custom envelopes.
boundaries.resolution: Implement complete native errno/category text and retain source/image/actual stderr observations. An unknown provider defect cannot masquerade as a native operating-system error.
